items.text: Leave her a competent portion of your estate for her support after your death.
items.quote: If any man at his death shall not leave his wife a competent portion of his estaite

items.text: Do not strike or correct her bodily, except in your own defense if she assaults you; if there is just cause for correction, complain to authority in court, and let her receive correction only from there.
items.quote: Everie marryed woeman shall be free from bodilie correction or stripes by her husband, unlesse it be in his owne defence upon her assalt.

items.text: Do not commit adultery; keep yourself only to your husband.
items.quote: If any person committeth Adultery with a maried or espoused wife, the Adulterer and Adulteresse shall surely be put to death.

items.text: See that he receives a double portion of the whole estate when the parents die intestate.
items.quote: the Elder sonne shall have a doble portion of his whole estate reall and personall

items.text: When parents die intestate with no male heirs, ensure their daughters inherit as copartners.
items.quote: their Daughters shall inherit as Copartners

items.text: Do not willfully and unreasonably deny any child timely or convenient marriage.
items.quote: If any parents shall wilfullie and unreasonably deny any childe timely or convenient mariage

items.text: Do not exercise unnatural severity towards your children.
items.quote: or shall exercise any unnaturall severitie towards them

items.text: Do not dispose of an orphan during minority without the consent of a court.
items.quote: No Orphan dureing their minoritie... shall afterwards be absolutely disposed of by any kindred... without the consent of some Court

items.text: Protect and sustain a servant who flees from the tyranny and cruelty of his master until due order is taken for his relief.
items.quote: they shall be there protected and susteyned till due order be taken for their relife.

items.text: Give speedy notice of the servant's flight to his master and to the nearest Assistant or Constable.
items.quote: due notice thereof be speedily given to their maisters from whom they fled. And the next Assistant or Constable

items.text: Do not put away a servant for more than a year to any other, either in your lifetime or after your death by executors or administrators, unless by consent of authority.
items.quote: No servant shall be put of for above a yeare to any other

items.text: Do not smite out the eye or tooth of your manservant or maidservant, or maim or disfigure them, unless by mere casualty; if you do, let them go free and give recompense.
items.quote: shall let them goe free from his service

items.text: Do not send away a servant who has served diligently and faithfully for seven years empty; give him his due.
items.quote: Servants that have served deligentlie and faithfully to the benefitt of their maisters seaven yeares, shall not be sent away emptie.

items.text: If you have been unfaithful, negligent, or unprofitable in your service, make satisfaction before dismissal.
items.quote: shall not be dismissed till they have made satisfaction
